title: Insert insole into shoe
setting: Footwear factory, seated on the floor
contact_roles: the right hand holds the insole while its thumb pinches it (carrying it and feeding it in, to 2.3 s), then touches it while it pushes the tail in and presses it flat with the fingers and palm; only the left hand holds the shoe.
masks_caveat: once the insole is inside the dark shoe (from about 2.9 s), its outline shrinks to a strip along the shoe's inner wall, and near the end (about 4.4 s) it isn't outlined at all, though the insole lies flat in plain view.
